sections.heading: Targeted Solutions for Complex Conditions
body: Generic treatment often leads to generic results. Our approach is built on the reality that a struggle with alcohol requires a different clinical roadmap than a struggle with fentanyl or methamphetamine. By focusing on the specific neurochemical and behavioral patterns of each substance, we provide a more direct path to healing. We offer:

items.title: Substance-Specific Detox
items.text: We provide tailored medical monitoring based on the specific withdrawal risks associated with each substance.

items.title: Customized Recovery Planning
items.text: Once stabilized we continue to use substance-specific behavioral health strategies to address the exact triggers and neurochemical changes associated with your history.

items.title: Integrated Behavioral Health
items.text: We address the co-occurring mental health triggers, such as anxiety or depression that often fuel dependency.

sections.heading: Leading Substance-Specific Treatment in Central Iowa
body: At Des Moines Wellness Center, we offer treatment for a range of addictions and co-occurring disorders. Every rehab program we provide was built by our own medical staff using 15 years of clinical experience. We focus on how each specific substance affects the body to ensure everyone in our care gets a precise path to recovery. Discover the rehab protocols our team developed for each condition:

items.title: Alcohol Use Disorder
items.text: Alcohol withdrawal requires precise medical management. Our Des Moines program provides a safe, clinical environment to navigate detox, followed by intensive therapy to address the root causes of Alcohol Use Disorder (AUD) and prevent chronic relapse.

items.title: Benzo Addiction
items.text: Withdrawing from benzodiazepines like Xanax or Valium is a complex process that demands a specialized, safe taper. We provide 24/7 medical supervision to manage anxiety and physical symptoms, ensuring a stabilized transition to long-term recovery.

items.title: Fentanyl Addiction
items.text: Given the extreme potency of synthetic opioids, fentanyl recovery requires high-acuity medical intervention. Our Des Moines team specializes in the specific detox requirements for fentanyl, followed by intensive residential and outpatient support.

items.title: Meth Addiction
items.text: Meth addiction can take a serious toll on both mental and physical health. Our evidence-based approach focuses on stabilizing the brain, reducing cravings, and helping clients rebuild structure, clarity, and long-term coping skills.

items.title: Prescription Drug Addiction
items.text: Misuse of prescription medications can quickly lead to dependence and serious health risks. Our treatment approach focuses on safe stabilization, managing withdrawal, and building the tools needed for lasting recovery.

items.title: Cocaine & Stimulants Addiction
items.text: Cocaine and stimulant use can lead to intense cravings and long-term neurological effects. Our treatment focuses on restoring balance, managing triggers, and building the coping skills needed for sustained recovery.

sections.heading: A Trusted Clinical Partner for Recovery in Iowa
Treating the Mental Health Triggers Behind Addiction
body: At the Des Moines Wellness Center, our medical staff recognizes that substance use rarely exists in a vacuum. To ensure long-term stabilization, every rehab program we provide is built to address the co-occurring mental health disorders that often fuel dependency. By treating the clinical root causes alongside the physical addiction, our team provides a more comprehensive path to recovery for patients coming from Central Iowa and beyond.

Our staff-led protocols are designed to manage the complexities of Major Depressive Disorder, Generalized Anxiety, and Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD). Whether a patient is struggling with the hyper-vigilance of trauma or the paralyzing effects of untreated bipolar disorder, our clinicians integrate psychiatric care and evidence-based therapy into the daily recovery schedule. This unified approach ensures that as the body heals from substance use, the mind is simultaneously stabilized, reducing the risk of relapse and restoring mental clarity.

sections.heading: Use Your Insurance for Addiction Rehab
body: We work with most major private insurance providers, including Wellmark Blue Cross Blue Shield, to make expert clinical care accessible. Our team offers a 100% confidential verification to help you understand your coverage and minimize out-of-pocket costs before you start.

faqs.q: How does the medical staff determine which program I need?
faqs.a: Our clinical team conducts a comprehensive intake assessment upon arrival. We don’t just look at the substance used; we evaluate your physical health, mental health history, and long-term goals to place you in the specific rehab track built for your condition.

faqs.q: What if I am struggling with more than one substance?
faqs.a: This is common. Because our medical staff has built specialized protocols for a range of addictions, we can integrate multiple tracks, such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines, into a single, safe clinical plan that addresses all dependencies simultaneously.

faqs.q: Do these programs include treatment for depression or anxiety?
faqs.a: Yes. Every substance-specific program we provide is designed to address co-occurring disorders. Our staff recognizes that mental health is a primary driver of addiction, so we treat both the substance use and the underlying condition at the same time.

faqs.q: How long are the rehab programs developed by your team?
faqs.a: While our staff has developed standard clinical roadmaps, the duration is flexible based on your progress. We focus on medical stabilization and psychological readiness rather than a generic 30-day clock.

faqs.q: Does my insurance cover all the substances listed on this page?
faqs.a: Most private insurance providers cover treatment for the full range of substances we treat. Our admissions team can provide a free, confidential verification to confirm your specific benefits for our Des Moines facility. Call us anytime at (888) 378-2158.
